items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The transcript contains no direct interaction or personal relationship described between Joe Thomas and Chick Webb. The interviewer mentions Webb in the context of playing an arrangement, but Joe Thomas does not respond with any personal connection to Webb.

ctx.x: He's the arranger for Sam Wooding at that time. And musicians in those days they like to trick you. Say anything to you. Say, well, (?.) so and so. ... So they put me in the first chair. You know, dig this. And ... Famous arrangement of his stamped off the band.' called the Naughty Waltz.
Oh, yeah. LATER Chick Webb did play-that.
... I always thought that Webb, he thought I was one of the few guys of the Henderson band that made it swing, that's what he always told me.
